system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free starting credit, FLUX-schnell costs $0.003 per image (~600 free images, then ultra-cheap PAYG)
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides incredibly fast and cheap API access to FLUX-schnell and SDXL with zero cold-starts, bypassing GitHub Actions IP blocklists common with AI Horde.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace failing image generation backends in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' via a simple Python post request.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires monitoring of remaining credit; needs a simple check to fall back to Pollinations when credits hit $0.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon registration, no credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An extremely fast, reliable, and cheap Google Search & Google Shopping scraper API that bypasses Google's bot detection entirely.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Inject into 'agent_opportunity_hunter' and 'agent_trendhunter' to discover trending search terms and competitor pricing on Etsy/Amazon.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Queries must be optimized and cached to prevent burning through the 2,500 free limit too quickly.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free API access, pay only when an order is placed by a customer.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic creation of products, generation of high-quality mockups, and direct publishing to connected Etsy, Shopify, or Printify Pop-up stores via API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Add a publishing step to 'produce_tumbler_wraps' and 'produce_wedding_stationery' to push products to a live store without manual UI clicking.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up store integrations (e.g., Etsy or Printify Pop-Up) beforehand.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list products, 88/12 revenue split (you keep 88% of sales).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Epic Games' unified marketplace (merging Sketchfab, Unreal Engine Marketplace, and Quixel). It is currently the highest-traffic hub for gamedev assets, 3D models, and 2D textures.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target distribution marketplace for 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' and 'produce_stl_parametric' outputs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Listing process is partially manual; assets must strictly comply with high technical standards to pass curation.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free trial credits (equivalent to roughly 1,000 FLUX-schnell or SDXL lightning generations).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers the fastest inference times on the market for modern models, with built-in upscaling (Real-ESRGAN) and controlnet pipelines via clean Python SDKs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate as a high-tier image generator for complex assets like 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' or detailed coloring book covers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict rate limits on free trial keys during peak hours; pricing plan is usage-based once trial expires.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous free tier with high RPM (Requests Per Minute) limits for Llama 3.1 (up to 405B) and Llama 3.2.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredibly high-speed text inference (hundreds of tokens per second) on open-weights models, perfect for heavy data processing and automated text generation.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Acts as the primary fast fallback LLM for metadata generation, SEO tag compilation, and niche description writing when Gemini hits rate limits.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free tier terms are subject to change as the platform transitions out of its developer preview phase.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fees. 5% + $0.50 transaction fee on sales. Handles global sales tax (merchant of record).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides an API-first storefront and checkout system, allowing Hugo to sell digital PDF guides, coloring books, and gamedev assets directly from a static site or GitHub Pages.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Create a completely automated direct-sales funnel where GitHub Actions publishes generated PDF books/assets and generates payment links automatically.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires driving organic traffic to the payment links, unlike Etsy or Amazon which have built-in search traffic.
